questions.question: How accurate is the AI model?
questions.answer: Our AI model achieves 92% accuracy on validation data, which is comparable to dermatologists. However, it's important to note that this tool is for educational and screening purposes only and should not replace professional medical diagnosis.

questions.question: Is my data secure and private?
questions.answer: Yes, absolutely. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We follow strict GDPR compliance and never share your medical information with third parties. Your uploaded images and scan results are stored securely and only accessible to you.

questions.question: Can I use this tool for medical diagnosis?
questions.answer: No. While our AI provides accurate analysis, this tool is designed for educational and screening purposes only. You should always consult a qualified dermatologist for professional diagnosis, treatment recommendations, and medical advice.

questions.question: What types of skin lesions can the AI detect?
questions.answer: The AI can identify 7 types of skin lesions: Melanoma, Basal Cell Carcinoma, Actinic Keratoses, Benign Keratosis-like lesions, Dermatofibroma, Melanocytic Nevi (moles), and Vascular Lesions.

questions.question: How do I take a good photo for analysis?
questions.answer: For best results: 1) Use good natural lighting, 2) Hold the camera steady and close enough to fill the frame with the lesion, 3) Ensure the image is in focus, 4) Avoid shadows or glare, 5) Take the photo straight-on rather than at an angle.

questions.question: What is Grad-CAM and why is it important?
questions.answer: Grad-CAM (Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping) is a visualization technique that shows which parts of the image the AI focused on when making its prediction. This provides transparency and helps you understand the AI's decision-making process.

questions.question: How long does the analysis take?
questions.answer: The AI analysis typically takes 2-5 seconds once you upload an image. The speed may vary depending on your internet connection and server load.

questions.question: Can I save my scan history?
questions.answer: Yes! When you create an account and sign in, all your scans are automatically saved to your history. You can access them anytime from the History page to track changes over time.

questions.question: What should I do if the AI detects something concerning?
questions.answer: If the AI detects a potentially malignant lesion (like Melanoma or Basal Cell Carcinoma) with high confidence, you should schedule an appointment with a dermatologist as soon as possible. Early detection is crucial for successful treatment.

questions.question: Is the service free?
questions.answer: Yes, DermaAI is currently free to use. We believe in making advanced skin cancer detection accessible to everyone.

questions.question: What devices and browsers are supported?
questions.answer: DermaAI works on all modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. For the best experience, we recommend using the latest version of your browser.

questions.question: Can I use the chatbot without uploading an image?
questions.answer: Yes! Our AI medical assistant can answer general questions about skin health, lesion types, and prevention tips even without a scan. However, for personalized advice based on your specific case, we recommend uploading an image first.
